retained_foundations.content: Elementary finite-dimensional Hermitian and real linear algebra; number-field rings of integers as Dedekind domains, local freeness of finite projective lattices, different/codifferent definitions and integral trace discriminants; elementary finite-index determinants, real scalar extension and local integrality; Lebesgue change of variables, Tonelli and countable additivity. The exact trace determinant, diagonal factor, rational lattice dictionary, group chart, fundamental domains and reference normalization are proved in this manuscript rather than retained as inputs.

An arbitrary original D7 and supplied HidaSetting with its literal coefficient isomorphism, actual unimodular L0 and Lam_split, hyperbolic vectors, all word vectors/local frames, finite frame congruences and xu. The CovolRef conclusion accepts every original bridge, both domains and HypX. This does not construct the ambient setting or infer Forms0. No extra measure, covolume, level-membership, row-lattice or discriminant hypothesis is imposed.

claim_bindings.scope: Original finite-unramified CM extension gives trace one, including characteristic2 residues; original complete splitting makes all prescribed different powers local units at both primes.
Source sigma-finite nonzero supported invariant measure becomes actual Haar on the specified closed unimodular subgroup, by explicit Tonelli identities and scalar comparison.
